item_summary: $70-100 acoustic desktop privacy panel with sound-absorbing recycled PET materials and a non-destructive clamp-on mounting system
detailed_item_draft: Item Specification: Desktop Acoustic Privacy Panel. Price Target: $70.00 to $100.00 USD per unit. Core Material: High-density acoustic felt composed of 100% recycled PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) fibers. Acoustic Performance: Minimum Noise Reduction Coefficient (NRC) of 0.85 to ensure effective sound dampening. Dimensions: Adjustable or fixed sizes suitable for standard desk heights (18" to 24" height, 24" to 32" width). Mounting System: Non-destructive clamp-on mechanism with adjustable jaws fitting desk thicknesses from 0.5" to 2.0". Clamps must feature heavy-duty steel construction with soft rubberized grips to prevent surface marring and ensure stability without drilling or screwing. Finish & Durability: Surface must be fire-resistant (Class A rating), moisture-resistant, and available in professional neutral colorways (e.g., charcoal, slate, cream). Sustainability: Preferably Global Recycled Standard (GRS) certified. Packaging: Must include protective foam corner guards and simplified installation guide. Compliance: Must meet ASTM E84 for flammability standards.
